description: E4 retrieval evaluation: hand-labelled questions. in_library entries name the guideline, the answer passage, the page range of that passage and the anchor sentence that answers the question; out_of_library questions have no answer in the library.

in_library.question: How does the no observed adverse effect level differ from the no observed effect level?

Under which circumstances may a safety factor smaller than the default be justified?
For which categories of therapeutics is dose scaling by milligrams per square metre not recommended?
Which factors can justify not defaulting to the most sensitive species when choosing the species for the human equivalent dose?
How can a pharmacologically active dose be compared with the maximum recommended starting dose?
Which dose should be used to calculate the human equivalent dose when drug absorption saturates below a toxic dose?
Are separate single-dose toxicity studies needed when acute toxicity information comes from other studies?
Which repeated-dose studies generally support clinical dosing for longer than six months?
Which genotoxicity assay is generally sufficient to support single-dose clinical trials?
Are stand-alone local tolerance studies recommended or should they be part of the general toxicity studies?
When should abuse liability be evaluated for a drug that acts on the central nervous system?
Are combination safety pharmacology or genotoxicity studies recommended when each agent was tested on its own?
When must juvenile animal studies be completed relative to long-term paediatric clinical trials?
In what order should repeat-dose toxicity studies be arranged in the toxicology written summary?
How many pages should the brief summary of the toxicology written summary generally take?
What is the expected length limit of the Nonclinical Overview?
What must the table of contents of the nonclinical study reports list?
What should the pharmacokinetics summary say about methods of analysis of biological samples?
Are carcinogenicity studies needed to support marketing of therapeutics for advanced cancer?
What is the usual basis for scaling animal doses to a human start dose for small molecule cancer drugs?
Do toxicology studies of combinations of anticancer drugs need to be run in general?
Are juvenile animal studies usually run to include paediatric cancer patients in trials?
What toxicokinetic evaluation applies to a conjugated anticancer product?
Are dedicated immunotoxicity studies needed for anticancer pharmaceuticals?

out_of_library.question: How do I cache dependencies in a continuous integration pipeline?
